correctness.rationale: The original full claim is algebraically sound: ordinary square-zero derivations have blocks T and f with T²=0, fT=0 and ω(Tu,v)+ω(u,Tv)=0. With W=im T isotropic and U=W^perp, the kernel quotient is U or a symplectic hyperplane U∩ker f, and its bracket rank is 2(n−rank D) in both cases, all characteristics. Rank d splits into T-ranks d and d−1; over the isotropic Grassmannian, invertible symmetric forms are an open irreducible vector-bundle locus and the inside/outside functional conditions are vector/open-bundle loci, giving dimensions d(2n−d+2) and one less. Earlier finite-field rank polynomial agrees; the full corrected theorem excludes novelty for that count and states only the kernel/geometric properties. The prior parametrization plus all-field fiber proof justifies the repaired result.
